business_scope.primary_industry_name: Polyresin Vacuum Casting and Hand-Painted Limited Edition Statues

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Spain–Argentina Bilateral Investment Treaty / Double Taxation Agreement (1992)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo; Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo, por el que se aprueba el Reglamento de la Ley 10/2010; Real Decreto 95/2018, de 9 de marzo, por el que se crea el Registro de Titularidades Reales; and Ley 1/2010, de 22 de julio, de Sociedades de Capital, for corporate-registry substance requirements.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Private_Internal (not publicly searchable; accessible to SEPBLAC, AEAT, judicial authorities, notaries and regulated AML/CFT obliged entities on a legitimate-interest and statutory basis)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Good Standing of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry or corporate registrar in the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization if the origin state is not party to the 1961 Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of constitutional documents (statutes/charter/articles) of each corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or notary of the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Duly executed Power of Attorney for incorporation of the Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada
UBO declaration forms and AML/KYC questionnaire
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Spanish notary or designated compliance service provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized, then Hague Apostille or consular legalization if signed outside Spain

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies and proof of address of all UBOs, directors and attorneys-in-fact
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National issuing authority / notary of the country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of each UBO, director, attorney-in-fact and account signatory against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UN Security Council sanctions lists, OFAC SDN list, domestic SEPBLAC alerts, PEP databases, and Spanish internal security/AML watchlists. Enhanced due diligence applies to PEPs, high-risk third countries, complex ownership chains, and any unusual pattern inconsistent with a low-risk polyresin statue business. Ongoing transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting obligations apply under Ley 10/2010 and Real Decreto 304/2014.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central – Sede Electrónica (Solicitud de Certificación de Denominación Social Negativa; accessible through the Colegio de Registradores de España and the CIRCE one-stop shop)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company denomination must be written in Latin script. Names may be in Spanish or any foreign language capable of romanization; non-Latin script names must be transliterated for the Spanish registry. The denomination must be lawful, distinctive, not contrary to public order, and not susceptible to confusion with existing Spanish or EU-registered company names.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: España, Estado, Gobierno, Ministerio, Presidencia, Administración Pública, Banco de España, Casa Real, Consejo General, Ayuntamiento, Diputación, and similar terms implying official or public sponsorship (require prior ministerial or administrative authorization)
Legal-form tokens such as S.A., S.L., S.L.U., S.Coop., and other regulated corporate abbreviations unless the incorporated form actually matches the intended entity
Identical or phonetically identical names already registered by another company in Spain or the European Union

Terms implying regulated financial, insurance, gaming, security, or public-utility activities without holding the corresponding license, including Banco, Seguros, Casino, Militar, Oficial, or Real when used misleadingly
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A granted negative name certificate is valid for six months and is not ordinarily extendable. If the name is rejected, the applicant may file an administrative appeal (recurso de alzada) before the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública within one month of notification, or may immediately request a new certificate using a different denomination. After expiration of the six-month reservation, a new application and payment of the applicable fee are required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditional. The Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada must maintain a registered office in Spain corresponding to its real place of administration or principal establishment. A virtual administrative address is acceptable for receiving correspondence and legal notices only if the resin-statue production, hand-painting, warehousing, or fulfillment activity is backed by a physical workshop, warehouse, or logistics contract in Spain. A pure virtual office without commercial substance creates non-compliance risk under Ley 1/2010 and Spanish tax-control principles.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15% probability of an unannounced AEAT, municipal, or labor inspection within the first 36 months for a low-risk standard-tier resin-statue business; the probability rises above 25% if a virtual-only office is used, inventory records are missing, or UBOs reside outside the EU.

Notarial deed of incorporation and draft by-laws

Sworn translation into Spanish and apostille/consular legalization of foreign corporate documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered or virtual office service for the first year

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank account opening and SL share capital deposit certificate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/KYC, PEP, OFAC, UN and domestic sanctions screening and UBO due-diligence file
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for standard low-risk corporate onboarding

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Spanish capital transactions tax (Modalidad de Operaciones Societarias at 1% of stated share capital)
SL minimum share capital deposit (refundable and held as company asset)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed market fee for Stage 1 corporate formation work

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Royal Legislative Decree 1/2010 approving the Spanish Companies Act (Ley de Sociedades de Capital), principally Articles 4, 20-23, 28-30, 32, 40-42, 58-62, 78-83, 210-212, 214-216, 225-232, 246-251, and 253-279; Law 14/2013 on entrepreneurs and internationalization; Law 18/2022, which permits a Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada to be incorporated with minimum capital of EUR 1.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: The Provincial Commercial Registry (Registro Mercantil Provincial) for the registered office location, under the coordination of the Colegio de Registradores de la Propiedad, Mercantiles y de Bienes Muebles de España.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Public deed of incorporation (escritura pública de constitución) granted before a Spanish notary and submitted for registration with the applicable Provincial Commercial Registry, together with the company bylaws and beneficial ownership information.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The statutory minimum capital is EUR 1, fully assumed and paid at incorporation. If capital is below EUR 3,000, at least 20% of annual profits must be allocated to legal reserve until the combined capital and reserve reach EUR 3,000; on liquidation, shareholders may have supplementary liability up to the difference between EUR 3,000 and the subscribed capital if company assets are insufficient. No statutory escrow account is required. A bank certificate of deposit may be replaced by the founders' express assumption of joint liability for the accuracy of the contribution under Article 62 of the Companies Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The Board resolves that: (1) the Company accepts and ratifies the subscription and full payment of its issued shares by the founding shareholder in accordance with the public deed and bylaws; (2) the registered office is adopted at [full Spanish address], with authority granted to update the address within the same municipality where permitted; (3) [name] is appointed sole director, or, if applicable, directors are appointed as stated in the deed, each accepting office and undertaking the statutory duties of diligence, loyalty, confidentiality, and conflict disclosure; and (4) the appointed officer is authorized to complete all registry, tax, banking, licensing, and operational formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirm Name Availability and Reserve Corporate Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Central Commercial Registry (Registro Mercantil Central), through its online name-certification service or authorized filing channel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to five proposed names, including the intended Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada designation or SL suffix. Obtain the negative name certificate, which is generally valid for three months for execution of the deed and reservable for six months. Ensure the name does not conflict with protected trademarks or misleading regulated terms.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney, if filed by an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Replace rejected names and resubmit. If the certificate is defective or delayed, request correction or administrative review through the Central Commercial Registry before expiry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare Founders, Capital, Bylaws, and Beneficial Ownership File
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish notary selected for execution of the incorporation deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the bylaws, ownership schedule, management structure, registered office, corporate purpose, share capital, share classes, transfer restrictions, financial year, and notification details. Obtain Spanish foreigner identification numbers for non-resident shareholders, directors, and beneficial owners where required. Legalize and apostille foreign corporate documents and provide sworn Spanish translations when applicable.
required_dossiers: Founders' passports or national identity documents
NIE or NIF documentation for relevant foreign persons and entities
Foreign entity constitutional documents and incumbency evidence
Apostille or legalization and sworn Spanish translations
Registered office evidence or lease authorization
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Cure missing identification, legalization, translation, authority, or beneficial ownership documents before signing. Obtain a notarial clarification or supplemental deed where the notary identifies a formal defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute the Public Deed and Evidence Capital Payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish notary public (notaría) before whom the deed is granted
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Sign the escritura pública de constitución. Pay the subscribed capital into a company account opened for incorporation and obtain a bank certificate, unless the deed expressly uses the founders' statutory joint-liability declaration permitted by Article 62. The notary verifies identity, authority, corporate name, bylaws, capital, and beneficial ownership information.
required_dossiers: Capital deposit certificate or Article 62 liability declaration
Identification and NIE or NIF records
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct discrepancies through the notary before execution. If the deed is refused, obtain the written reason, cure the defect, and request re-execution or notarial review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Initial Tax Identification and File Incorporation Tax Formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish Tax Agency (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria), online or through the relevant tax office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the provisional company NIF using Form 036 and the public deed or equivalent incorporation evidence. File the exempt corporate transaction declaration for the incorporation under the Spanish transfer and stamp tax regime where required by the tax office or autonomous community. After registration, submit the registered deed and obtain the definitive NIF.
required_dossiers: Public incorporation deed or certified copy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct Form 036 inconsistencies, provide the registered deed, and resubmit electronically or at the competent tax office. Challenge an adverse tax-office decision through the applicable administrative appeal route.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the Company with the Provincial Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Commercial Registry for the registered office, through the registry filing desk or electronic notarial filing system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized deed, bylaws, provisional NIF, beneficial ownership data, and any required registry forms. Pay the regulated notarial and commercial registry tariffs, which are variable and are not a single fixed state incorporation fee. Confirm registration, obtain the registry information, and update the company NIF to definitive status.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of registry tariffs
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a qualification notice, correct the defect within the stated period, submit a supplemental deed or clarification, and request re-entry. A negative qualification may be appealed to the Directorate-General for Legal Security and Public Faith or challenged before the competent court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete Post-Incorporation Governance and Tax Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish Tax Agency, Social Security Treasury, and relevant autonomous-community or municipal authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Adopt the first board or sole shareholder resolutions, confirm officers, open the operating bank account, activate the definitive NIF, register the economic activity through Form 036, and enroll directors or employees in the applicable Social Security regimes. Legalize mandatory company books electronically through the Commercial Registry and establish accounting, invoicing, related-party, and beneficial ownership records.
required_dossiers: First board or sole shareholder resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct rejected electronic filings, provide missing officer or beneficial ownership information, and resubmit to the relevant authority. Late registrations should be regularized promptly and assessed for penalties or surcharge exposure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Secure Premises, Municipal Activity, and Operational Approvals
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal town hall (Ayuntamiento) and, where applicable, the competent autonomous-community industry and environmental authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before commencing production, confirm zoning compatibility for resin casting, painting, storage, and dispatch. File the applicable declaración responsable, comunicación previa, or licencia de actividad and opening authorization. Obtain technical certificates for premises, ventilation, fire protection, electrical systems, waste handling, and occupational safety. Do not operate machinery or handle regulated chemicals before the applicable municipal filing or permit becomes effective.
required_dossiers: Chemical inventory and safety data sheets
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to municipal technical observations, amend the technical report, and resubmit. Challenge a refusal through the applicable administrative appeal and judicial review procedures; suspend operations if the authority identifies an immediate safety or environmental risk.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: The competent industry authority of the relevant autonomous community, together with the municipality's licensing department. Spain has no single nationwide manufacturing licensing board for ordinary resin statue production; industrial registration, machinery, electrical, pressure-equipment, and activity controls are allocated between autonomous communities and municipalities.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal licencia de actividad y apertura, or declaración responsable/comunicación previa de actividad and opening, depending on the municipality and premises risk classification; where applicable, registration in the autonomous-community Industrial Establishment Registry (Registro Integrado Industrial).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: The competent environmental authority of the relevant autonomous community, applying Law 21/2013 on Environmental Assessment and coordinated with the Ministry for the Ecological Transition and the Demographic Challenge where nationally competent
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Generally exempt from project-level full EIA for small-scale polyresin vacuum casting and hand-painted statue production, unless the premises, process, emissions, location, capacity, or associated infrastructure falls within Annexes I or II of Law 21/2013 or applicable regional legislation. A municipal environmental or activity review may still be mandatory.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Comply with the municipal sewer ordinance and applicable water authority discharge conditions; do not discharge resin, pigments, solvents, uncured chemicals, or contaminated wash water without authorization. Assess VOC obligations under Royal Decree 117/2003 where listed solvent-using activities or thresholds apply. Apply Law 7/2022 on waste and contaminated soils, segregate hazardous resin, solvent, pigment, and contaminated packaging waste, use authorized waste managers, maintain records, and comply with any permit-specific noise and air-emission limits.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Obtain the municipal or competent authority fire-safety acceptance required by the activity filing, applying the Technical Building Code fire provisions and the industrial fire-safety regulation where industrial-premises thresholds apply. Verify structural loads, ventilation, electrical installations, machinery guarding, emergency routes, and storage compatibility through qualified technical certification. Implement Law 31/1995 on Occupational Risk Prevention, chemical-agent controls, safety data sheets, personal protective equipment, exposure assessments, emergency procedures, and mandatory worker training. Secure required certificates for low-voltage installations, fire systems, and any pressure equipment before operation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) — official portal: sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Obtain Número de Identificación de Extranjero (NIE) for each non-resident director/shareholder. Step 2: Reserve the corporate name at the Registro Mercantil Central (certificación negativa de denominación). Step 3: Execute the SL deed before a Spanish notary and apply to AEAT for the provisional CIF (Código de Identificación Fiscal) via Modelo 036/037; the provisional CIF converts to a definitive NIF once registration in the Registro Mercantil is completed. Step 4: File Modelo 036 to enroll in the Spanish tax census (Censo de Empresarios), elect the VAT regime, and register for Impuesto sobre Sociedades. Step 5: Obtain an AEAT digital certificate for online filings. Foreign entities lacking a permanent establishment must appoint a tax representative in Spain.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the SL is a separate taxpayer subject to Impuesto sobre Sociedades at 25% on worldwide income (15% reduced rate for newly incorporated companies in the first two profitable tax periods; 23% reduced rate may apply to the first EUR 500,000 of small-SL profits). Non-resident dividend distributions are subject to withholding tax, reduced under applicable double tax treaties.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists; SLs are mandatorily entity-level taxed. Available elections and special regimes: (i) consolidated corporate tax regime (régimen de consolidación fiscal) requiring ≥70% direct or indirect ownership; (ii) ETVE holding company regime for foreign dividends and capital gains; (iii) patent box and R&D tax credit elections; (iv) VAT simplified, cash-basis, or cooperative special regimes where the SL qualifies; (v) ATAD hybrid-mismatch disallowance rules under Law 27/2014 article 15 bis.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido) — Spanish VAT aligned with EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No VAT registration threshold applies; every entity performing economic activities in Spain must register (Modelo 036/037) before commencing. For the simplified VAT regime, the prior-year supply of goods cap is EUR 250,000, but SL entities generally cannot use this regime.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Large enterprises (turnover exceeding EUR 6,000,000) must transmit SII (Suministro Inmediato de Información) invoice records to AEAT within 4 calendar days (8 days in July); an SL resin-statue home-kit manufacturer below this threshold files Modelo 303 quarterly and Modelo 390 annually. Mandatory B2B electronic invoicing and software integrity rules apply under Ley Crea y Crece (Law 18/2022) and Verifactu (RD 1007/2023), with interoperable e-invoice XML/QR stamp obligations phased in during 2025–2026 by taxpayer size. No real-time fiscal clearance blocking exists, but invoice data must be preserved and reproducible on AEAT audit request.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of resin statues and goods to non-EU third countries qualify for the 0% VAT exemption with credit under Ley 37/1992 article 21.1, provided the goods physically leave EU territory within 90 days of dispatch and the exporter obtains AEAT validation via REGIMEX/CUSDEC. Services directly related to exported goods and offshore services (article 69 LIVA) are 0% rated when the recipient is established outside the EU; comprehensive documentary evidence must be retained.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: DUA/Documento Único Administrativo (EU Single Administrative Document export declaration; copy bearing the EORI number and AEAT exit validation)
Commercial invoice (factura comercial) stating Incoterms, HS code, quantity, and declared export value
Packing list (lista de embalaje/bultos) with container and seal numbers
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or CMR signed transport document evidencing physical exit from EU territory
Proof of payment and inward remittance (justificante de cobro) including SWIFT/MT103 or bank certificate
Contract or purchase order for offshore services export and delivery confirmation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT strictly audits export disproportionality and documentation; failure to prove EU exit within one month after the 90-day deadline triggers VAT assessment at 21% plus statutory late-payment interest and surcharges. Deliberate false zero-rating constitutes a serious/very serious infringement under Ley 58/2003 articles 184 and 187, with penalties up to 150% of the underpaid VAT and retrospective clawback of the 0% benefit; criminal tax fraud under Código Penal article 305 applies where the amount exceeded EUR 120,000, carrying imprisonment of up to 5 years and director and tax-representative liability.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain), in coordination with the Directorate General for International Trade and Investments (Dirección General de Comercio Internacional e Inversiones – DGCIIN) of the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Business for capital-movement oversight
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain is a euro-area jurisdiction with full currency convertibility under the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Articles 63-66). Both current-account and capital-account transactions are unrestricted for residents and non-residents; profit remittance and dividend distribution to non-resident shareholders are freely transferable, subject to the domestic 19% non-resident dividend withholding tax, which may be reduced under a double-tax treaty or exempted under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive. No prior FX authorization is required for capital inflow or outflow, but all cross-border payments exceeding €12,500 per transaction or €50,000 in annual positions must be reported statistically to the Bank of Spain via BS-1 declarations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Spain imposes no mandatory surrender, conversion quota, or statutory repatriation timeline for export proceeds. Exporters may freely retain foreign currency receipts in domestic or offshore accounts. The only compulsory obligation is the statistical/financial reporting of balances and transactions under the Bank of Spain's Circular 4/2012 (Declaration of Transactions and Positions), including threshold-based declarations. Non-compliance can trigger administrative fines but does not restrict export flows or profit allocation.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account EUR / Foreign Currency Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Medium. Spanish-licensed or EEA-passported electronic money institutions (EMIs) can provide multi-currency IBANs via PSD2 and real-time SEPA/SEPA Instant rails, with optional SWIFT-access partner banks. Legal constraints: an EMI cannot grant credit, must safeguard client funds in tier-one custodial accounts, and must perform full KYC/AML equivalent to banks. For this low-risk resin-statue business, an EMI is viable as a collection gateway for preorder deposits and PayPal/Stripe settlement, but obscurity and counterparty limits mean that the primary treasury ledger should reside with a licensed credit institution. Offshore non-EEA EMIs are not recommended due to lack of depositor protection and potential prohibition on commercial activity without a Spanish branch.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance is not an absolute legal mandate for Spanish limited-company banking. A non-resident director or shareholder may complete onboarding remotely if the bank's digital onboarding procedure is approved and the signatory has a valid eID or if a Spanish legal representative acts under a notarized power of attorney. In practice, all tier-one banks require the following for remote opening: (a) original or apostilled certificate of incorporation, (b) certified Spanish translation, (c) NIE (Número de Identificación de Extranjeros) for every director/UBO, (d) company tax reference (CIF/NIF), and (e) proof of registered office in Spain. Banks may still request one in-person interview for high-risk jurisdictions; Spain/EU jurisdictions with low AML risk usually pass video identification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume pre-order deposits received via Stripe/PayPal before physical production is documented
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial invoice with itemized product SKU, manufacturing timeline, refund policy, Stripe/PayPal payout reports, and customer identity excerpts (pseudonymized where required); purchase orders for resin and packaging materials from suppliers; customs declarations for prior sample shipments.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Invoicing of limited-edition statues at prices above the standard market range for resin collectibles
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent art-valuation or auction-house comparative appraisal; insurance policy for the collection; certificate of authenticity and edition-numbering registry; escrow agreement or intellectual-property license showing exclusivity premium.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments from mixed-source vehicles (PayPal personal accounts, third-party prepaid cards) with subsequent refunds to different instruments
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written refund policy strictly requiring refunds only to the original payment instrument; reconciliation ledger mapping transaction IDs; evidence of goods physical dispatch (tracked courier, customs form CN22/CN23); internal fraud-prevention procedure summary.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The shareholder subscribes the capital via an incoming SWIFT MT103 from a personal or corporate account, using purpose code 'EQUI' (equity injection) and the Spanish descriptive code 'Aportación de capital social – Constitución SL'. The bank will require a certified copy of the deed of incorporation evidencing the capital subscription and the depositary certificate (certificación bancaria de desembolso) issued by the receiving bank. For amounts above €10,000, the origin of funds must be documented (salary slips, sale agreement, or liquidation certificate of an existing entity), and anti-money-laundering proof may include a sworn statement of lawful origin. The NIF provisional or definitive of the SL must be displayed on the transfer reference.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational trade settlements for resin materials, packaging, and outsourced sculpture painting are routed through: (a) SWIFT MT103 for non-EU suppliers (China, Vietnam, USA) with purpose code 'Merchandise trade' and supporting invoice, packing list, bill of lading, and inspection certificate; (b) a commercial documentary letter of credit (UCP600) for bulk orders exceeding an agreed threshold to secure both sides; (c) SEPA CT payment for EU-based tooling and workshop costs; (d) PayPal/Stripe payouts to affiliates or refunds, strictly with a Sidebar clearing schedule. Spanish banks may require presentation of the commercial invoice and freight document within 30 days of wire execution for regulatory statistical reporting.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forwards (EUR/CNY, EUR/USD) executed under a standard documented ISDA Master Agreement or a simplified European Banking Authority-compliant FX Forward contract with a Spanish or EU credit institution.
Cross-currency swaps (EUR/CNY, EUR/USD) for medium-term commercial balances, subject to corporate treasury authorization and underlying trade-flow verification.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on CNY or illiquid emerging-market currencies with a licensed EU bank, permitted solely where an economic exposure exists and cannot be settled in deliverable form.
FX options (call/spreads) purchased from a licensed Spanish or EU investment firm for limited downside protection, with no speculative premium beyond 120 days' projected trade exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of Annual Accounts (Cuentas Anuales) with the Mercantile Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 4 months after the end of the financial year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines between 300 and 60,000 euros, with risk of company dissolution

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Modelo 347 Annual Declaration of Operations with Third Parties
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines from 100 to 600,000 euros based on transaction volume

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if net turnover exceeds 2,000,000 EUR, total assets exceed 1,000,000 EUR, or average number of employees exceeds 50
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (Plan General de Contabilidad)

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual update and confirmation of the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (UBO Register) and shareholding details with the Registro Mercantil

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate for newly created entities during the first two years of positive taxable income (subject to conditions). Additional incentives include R&D tax credits (up to 42% for qualifying expenses), patent box regime (50% exemption on qualifying IP income), and deductions for export activities and job creation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 200 (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) filed electronically via the AEAT website (www.agenciatributaria.es)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 25 days following the six months after the fiscal year-end (e.g., for a December 31 year-end, deadline is July 25 of the following year).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax identification number (NIF) and corporate details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident entities must provide their foreign tax ID and Spanish permanent establishment (PE) reference if applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting profit (resultado contable) before tax adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-residents with a PE, report income attributable to the PE only.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Permanent differences (e.g., non-deductible expenses, exempt income)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Adjust for items not deductible under Spanish tax law; ensure treaty exemptions are properly claimed.
Apply Spanish depreciation rules; for PE, use consistent accounting policies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable base (base imponible) after offsetting prior-year tax losses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Offset losses only if legally available; non-residents may offset losses from the same PE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax rate and gross tax liability
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply standard 25% rate or reduced 15% if eligible; non-residents with PE use same rates.
Claim treaty relief, double tax credits, and any applicable incentives; attach supporting documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final tax payable or refund due
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure all payments are made via the AEAT system; non-residents must use a Spanish bank account or authorized intermediary.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 5% of the tax due for the first month, plus 1% per additional month, up to 20%. Fixed penalty of €200 for late filing without tax due. Surcharges for late payment: 5% (within 3 months), 10% (3-6 months), 15% (6-12 months), 20% (over 12 months) plus late interest.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 202 (Pago fraccionado) – quarterly corporate income tax prepayment, filed electronically via AEAT
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within the first 20 calendar days of April, July, October, and January (for the preceding quarter).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable base for the quarter (based on accounting profit of the year-to-date)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents with PE must compute based on PE income; use the same method as annual return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable percentage (typically 18% for large companies, 17% for others, or 25% if using the alternative method)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents with PE follow the same percentage rules as domestic entities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amount to be paid (after deducting prior quarterly payments and withholdings)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure proper offset of any tax credits or treaty relief.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 5% of the amount due for the first month, plus 1% per additional month, up to 20%. Late payment surcharges as described for Form 200.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 19% (unless reduced under EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive or applicable tax treaty)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim reduced withholding tax under a tax treaty, the non-resident beneficiary must submit Form 210 (Impuesto sobre la Renta de No Residentes) to the AEAT, attaching a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the tax authority of the residence country. The TRC must be apostilled or legalized and translated into Spanish if required. The payer must also obtain a copy of the TRC and file it with the withholding tax return. For EU/EEA entities, the Parent-Subsidiary Directive may allow a 0% rate if the parent holds at least 5% of the subsidiary's capital for at least one year.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: Royalties – 24%; Interest – 19%. Treaty rates may reduce these (e.g., under the OECD Model, interest often 10%, royalties 10% or 5% depending on IP type). For EU, the Interest and Royalties Directive may provide 0% withholding if conditions are met (e.g., 25% ownership for at least two years).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File required if net turnover exceeds €10 million; Master File required if the group's consolidated turnover exceeds €50 million. Additionally, Form 232 (Información de operaciones vinculadas) must be filed if related-party transactions exceed €250,000 per counterparty or €1 million in total.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Spain does not have a specific Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) regime like the UAE, but applies general anti-abuse rules (GAAR) and the doctrine of 'substance over form'. For holding companies, the Spanish tax authorities may challenge structures lacking commercial substance, and the EU Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive (ATAD) provisions on controlled foreign companies (CFC) and interest limitation rules apply. A Spanish SL must demonstrate real economic activity (e.g., employees, premises, decision-making) to benefit from treaty relief and avoid being classified as a shell company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of income, overstatement of deductions, or failure to file tax returns with intent to evade taxes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of 50% to 150% of the tax evaded, plus late interest. Criminal prosecution for tax fraud exceeding €120,000 may result in imprisonment from 1 to 5 years and a fine of up to six times the defrauded amount.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for tax debts if they fail to exercise due diligence, and may face criminal charges, travel bans, and seizure of personal assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a mere conduit with no real business activity, no employees, no physical presence, or no commercial substance, particularly to obtain treaty benefits or avoid tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of treaty benefits, recharacterization of transactions, and imposition of additional tax (up to 25% of the recharacterized income). Administrative penalties up to €10,000 for non-compliance with substance documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be jointly liable for the company's tax liabilities if they knowingly participated in the sham arrangement, and may face disqualification from serving as directors.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to implement AML procedures, accepting cash payments above €10,000 without reporting, or facilitating money laundering through the company's accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to €150,000 for serious infractions, and up to €1.5 million for very serious infractions. Criminal liability for money laundering can lead to imprisonment from 6 months to 6 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be held criminally liable if they knowingly participate in or fail to prevent money laundering, leading to imprisonment, fines, and travel bans.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain adequate transfer pricing documentation, or applying non-arm's length prices in related-party transactions, leading to profit shifting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Adjustment of taxable income, penalty of 15% of the adjusted amount (or 25% if the adjustment exceeds €1 million), plus late interest. Failure to file Form 232 incurs a penalty of €1,000 per data item, with a minimum of €10,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally liable for penalties if they knowingly approved non-compliant transfer pricing policies, and may face disqualification from managing companies.
